propositions: Fourteen call sites in src/rebar/llm hand-build identical single-turn structured requests with copy-paste code, creating maintenance burden and silent omission of bounds
RunRequest contract requires single_turn + structured mode + output_schema consistency but nothing enforces it, leading to unbounded sites like judge_one remaining unnoticed
Only two of fourteen sites declare lowering-only seams (judge_batch bounds, completion_recovery token cap), and omission is silent—indistinguishable from deliberate unbounding
A shared RunRequest.for_structured() classmethod with required SingleTurnBounds argument will make bounds decisions explicit and enforceable across all fourteen sites
The existing site oracle in test_subcall_class_selection.py matches only RunRequest(...) calls and will become invisible to the classmethod variant, requiring matcher update but no assertion changes
